verdict.rationale: Adyen docs explicitly describe a test Customer Area with an orderable Adyen test card supporting different card brands, CVMs, and declined payments, plus a 'basic testing system to simulate transaction scenarios' — directly matching the story. However, this is described as basic/limited rather than a full reader simulator, and community feedback describes friction and hundreds of hours integrating the card-present/terminal flow, suggesting real-world testing experience is more painful than docs imply.
